verified_title: Against the Monolithic Wireless World Model: Why NextG Needs Composable and Agentic Intelligence
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2605.16689: Against the Monolithic Wireless World Model: Why NextG Needs Composable and Agentic Intelligence
method_summary: The paper argues that wireless data and tasks depend strongly on configuration, simulators and operational objectives. It advocates composable intelligence connecting classical processing, digital twins and bounded agentic components instead of assuming a single universal monolithic predictor.
evidence_and_limits: Position/architecture argument, not a reproduced controller baseline or theorem that one architecture must win.
